dict.string: Albedian takes your night photo with the camera and keeps it exactly as the camera wrote it.
Albedian records which way the phone pointed for each photo, as a hint for finding its stars.
Albedian uses your location while you aim to find true north and the sky above you, and sends it only to Albedian on your laptop.
Albedian sends your photo and where the phone pointed to your laptop on this network.
